svg.title: Fotolo services
svg.text: Everything server-side runs as one Docker Swarm stack. Media never passes through it: the app fetches images straight from Azure Blob Storage.
stack fotolo · swarm/docker-compose.yml · stateful services pinned to the manager node
Grafana dashboards: overview · logs & traces · product
backend overlay network: every service except cloudflared
blobs are named by the SHA-256 of the original upload
GET images directly (URLs come from the API)
Uploads (max 25 MB) are processed inline: hash, validate ≤ 50 MP, WebP 2048
px + 400 px thumbnail, thumbhash, EXIF read. Post photos are cropped square,
Rate limits, in memory per replica: 100 req/min per user (or IP), 15/min per
IP on login, register and refresh.
Client IP comes from CF-Connecting-IP, trusted only from the edge network.
The API only inserts votes. Elo, wins, losses and trending are written by
The API is stateless; scale it with SERVER_REPLICAS.
